Operational Excellence Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and runbooks. Contribute to documentation, knowledge base updates, and process improvements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Dev Ops, engineering, and support teams. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience). Basic to intermediate knowledge of cloud platforms (GCP and/or Azure). Understanding of: Server patching and maintenance Networking fundamentals SSL/TLS certificates and security concepts Familiarity with deployment processes and CI/CD pipelines. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to work in a 24x7 support environment (shift-based if applicable). Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with Linux/Windows server administration. Exposure to monitoring and alerting tools. Basic scripting knowledge (Shell, Python, or similar). Experience working in a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or production support environment.
